seo.title: Book a Pilates Class in Limassol | KLUB
seo.description: Booking for KLUB Pilates Limassol opens with our September 2026 launch. Join the founding member list for first access, or message us to reserve your spot personally.

hero.heading: Booking Opens Soon
hero.intro: Online booking goes live shortly before we open in September 2026. Founding members book first.

firstAccess.heading: Get first access
firstAccess.text: Join the founding member list — early rates, priority booking, the address before anyone else.

reserve.heading: Reserve a spot personally
reserve.text: Want to lock in a class the human way? Message us with your preferred class and time and we'll confirm within a few hours.
